question: How do I reset my password?
answer: You can reset your password by clicking "Forgot Password" on the login page and following the email instructions.
context: The system allows users to reset passwords using email verification for security reasons.

question: How do I update my email address on file?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Profile and edit the email field, then confirm the change via the verification link sent to your new address.
context: Email changes require confirmation to prevent unauthorized account takeovers.

question: Can I merge two accounts into one?
answer: Currently accounts cannot be merged automatically; contact support with both account emails and we will manually transfer your data.
context: Account merging is a manual backend process handled by the support team.

question: How do I delete my account permanently?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Privacy > Delete Account and confirm; this action is irreversible and removes all your data within 30 days.
context: Account deletion follows a 30-day grace period before permanent data removal.

question: Why is my account showing as suspended?
answer: Accounts are usually suspended due to suspicious activity, failed payments, or a violation of terms of service; check your email for the specific reason.
context: Suspension notices are automatically emailed with the triggering reason code.

question: How do I change my display name?
answer: Navigate to Account Settings > Profile and edit the "Display Name" field, then click Save to update it instantly.
context: Display name changes are reflected across the platform immediately after saving.

question: Is it possible to have multiple users on one account?
answer: Yes, on Business and Enterprise plans you can invite team members under Account Settings > Team Members.
context: Multi-user access is restricted to higher-tier subscription plans.

question: Why was I charged twice this month?
answer: Duplicate charges usually occur from a failed payment retry; please contact billing support with your invoice ID for a refund review.
context: Payment gateways sometimes trigger retry charges when the first attempt is flagged as pending.

question: How do I update my credit card information?
answer: Go to Billing > Payment Methods and click "Edit" next to your current card to enter the new details.
context: Payment method updates apply to all future billing cycles automatically.

question: Can I get an invoice for my last payment?
answer: Yes, invoices are available under Billing > Invoice History, where you can download them as PDF files.
context: Invoices are auto-generated at the time of each successful transaction.

question: Why did my subscription price increase?
answer: Prices may increase due to plan upgrades, promotional period expiration, or scheduled price changes announced via email in advance.
context: Pricing changes are communicated at least 30 days before taking effect.

question: Do you offer annual billing discounts?
answer: Yes, annual billing offers a 15% discount compared to monthly payments, applied automatically at checkout when you select the yearly plan.
context: Annual discounts are built into the pricing table shown during checkout.

question: How can I add a VAT number to my invoices?
answer: Go to Billing > Tax Information and enter your VAT number; it will appear on all future invoices.
context: VAT details are stored separately from payment information for compliance purposes.

question: What happens if my payment fails?
answer: We retry the payment three times over five days; if it still fails, your account is downgraded to the free plan.
context: Failed payment handling follows a retry schedule before service restriction.

question: Can I switch from monthly to yearly billing mid-cycle?
answer: Yes, you can switch anytime in Billing > Subscription, and we will prorate the remaining balance of your current cycle.
context: Billing cycle switches are prorated to avoid double charging customers.

question: How long does a refund take to process?
answer: Refunds typically take 5-7 business days to appear on your original payment method after approval.
context: Refund processing time depends on the payment provider's settlement schedule.

question: Am I eligible for a refund after 30 days?
answer: Refunds are generally only available within 30 days of purchase, though exceptions may be made for service outages or billing errors.
context: The 30-day window is standard policy across all subscription tiers.

question: Can I get a partial refund for an unused subscription period?
answer: Yes, if you cancel mid-cycle we can issue a prorated refund for the unused days upon request.
context: Prorated refunds are calculated based on daily usage rate of the plan.

question: Why was my refund request denied?
answer: Refund requests are denied if the purchase falls outside the eligibility window or violates the no-refund policy for digital downloads.
context: Digital goods have stricter refund rules due to instant delivery and non-returnability.

question: How do I check the status of my refund?
answer: You can track your refund status under Billing > Refund History, which shows real-time updates from processing to completion.
context: Refund status updates sync with the payment processor's transaction records.

question: Can I get a refund if I was charged after cancelling?
answer: Yes, if you were charged after a confirmed cancellation, contact support immediately for a full refund of the erroneous charge.
context: Post-cancellation charges are treated as billing errors and refunded in full.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: You can track your order using the tracking link sent to your email, or by visiting Orders > Order History on your account.
context: Tracking numbers are generated once the order is handed to the shipping carrier.

question: Can I cancel an order after placing it?
answer: Orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of placement; after that, they enter processing and cannot be cancelled.
context: The 1-hour window exists before orders are sent to the fulfillment warehouse.

question: How do I change the shipping address on an existing order?
answer: If the order hasn't shipped yet, go to Order History and click "Edit Address"; once shipped, the address cannot be changed.
context: Address edits are only possible before the fulfillment stage begins.

question: Why is my order still marked as processing?
answer: Orders may stay in processing due to high demand, stock verification, or payment confirmation delays of up to 48 hours.
context: Processing delays are most common during peak sales periods.

question: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
answer: Unfortunately, orders placed separately cannot be combined once submitted, even if placed on the same day.
context: Each order is processed independently through the fulfillment system.

question: How do I reorder a previous purchase?
answer: Go to Order History, select the past order, and click "Reorder" to add the same items to your cart instantly.
context: The reorder feature copies item details but not the original pricing if prices changed.

question: What should I do if I received the wrong item?
answer: Contact support with your order number and a photo of the item received; we will arrange a free replacement or refund.
context: Wrong-item cases are prioritized for expedited resolution.

question: How much does standard shipping cost?
answer: Standard shipping costs $4.99 for orders under $50 and is free for orders over $50.
context: Shipping thresholds are based on the pre-tax order subtotal.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries; international shipping costs and delivery times vary by destination.
context: International shipping availability is determined by carrier partnerships in each region.

question: Why is my package delayed?
answer: Delays can result from weather conditions, customs processing, or high carrier volume during peak seasons.
context: Shipping carriers provide delay reasons through tracking status updates.

question: Can I change my delivery speed after checkout?
answer: Delivery speed can be changed within 2 hours of checkout by contacting support, provided the order hasn't shipped.
context: Delivery speed changes require manual intervention before warehouse dispatch.

question: What happens if my package is marked delivered but I never received it?
answer: Report it to support within 48 hours; we will investigate with the carrier and send a replacement if it's confirmed lost.
context: Carrier investigations typically take 3-5 business days to resolve.

question: Do you offer same-day delivery?
answer: Same-day delivery is available in select metro areas for orders placed before 12 PM local time.
context: Same-day delivery eligibility is checked automatically based on the shipping zip code.

question: How do I get a shipping cost estimate before checkout?
answer: Add items to your cart and enter your zip code on the cart page to see an estimated shipping cost before checkout.
context: Shipping estimates use real-time rates from our carrier integrations.

question: I can't log in even though my password is correct. What should I do?
answer: Try clearing your browser cache or using incognito mode; if the issue persists, your account may be temporarily locked after failed attempts.
context: Accounts lock automatically after 5 consecutive failed login attempts for security.

question: Why do I keep getting logged out automatically?
answer: This usually happens due to session timeout settings or if you're logged in on multiple devices simultaneously.
context: Session timeouts default to 30 minutes of inactivity for security compliance.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Security and toggle on Two-Factor Authentication, then follow the QR code setup with an authenticator app.
context: Two-factor authentication adds a second verification layer beyond passwords.

question: I lost access to my two-factor authentication device. How do I log in?
answer: Use one of your saved backup codes to log in, or contact support to verify your identity and reset 2FA.
context: Backup codes are generated during initial 2FA setup for recovery purposes.

question: Can I log in using Google or Facebook?
answer: Yes, social login is supported; click "Continue with Google" or "Continue with Facebook" on the login page.
context: Social login uses OAuth to authenticate without storing a separate password.

question: Why does the login page keep showing an error?
answer: This is often caused by outdated browser cookies or a temporary server issue; refreshing or trying a different browser usually resolves it.
context: Login errors are logged with error codes visible in browser developer tools.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Subscription and click "Cancel Subscription"; you'll retain access until the end of the current billing period.
context: Cancellations take effect at the end of the paid period, not immediately.

question: Can I pause my subscription instead of cancelling?
answer: Yes, the Pause option under Subscription Settings lets you freeze billing for up to 3 months.
context: Pausing retains your account data while temporarily halting charges.

question: What's the difference between the Pro and Premium plans?
answer: The Pro plan includes core features for individuals, while Premium adds team collaboration, priority support, and advanced analytics.
context: Plan comparisons are detailed on the pricing page under Features Comparison.

question: Will I lose my data if I downgrade my plan?
answer: Your data is retained, but some features may become inaccessible if they exceed the limits of your new plan.
context: Downgrades restrict feature access rather than deleting existing data.

question: How do I upgrade my subscription mid-cycle?
answer: Go to Subscription Settings, select the new plan, and the price difference will be prorated and charged immediately.
context: Upgrades take effect instantly with prorated billing adjustments.

question: Does my subscription auto-renew?
answer: Yes, all subscriptions auto-renew by default unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
context: Auto-renewal is standard across monthly and annual subscription plans.

question: Can I get a free trial extension?
answer: Trial extensions are occasionally granted for technical issues; contact support with details to request one.
context: Trial extensions are handled case-by-case rather than automatically.

question: The app keeps crashing on my phone. What should I do?
answer: Try updating to the latest app version, restarting your device, and clearing the app cache before reopening.
context: App crashes are frequently resolved by updating to the latest patched release.

question: Why is the website loading so slowly?
answer: Slow loading can be caused by browser extensions, poor internet connection, or high server traffic during peak hours.
context: Performance issues are monitored via server load dashboards in real time.

question: How do I clear my browser cache?
answer: Go to your browser settings, find "Privacy" or "History," and select "Clear Browsing Data," making sure cached files are included.
context: Cached data can cause outdated content to display incorrectly.

question: I'm getting a "500 Internal Server Error." What does that mean?
answer: This indicates a temporary server-side issue; please try again in a few minutes or contact support if it persists.
context: 500 errors are logged automatically and reviewed by the engineering team.

question: Why can't I upload files larger than 10MB?
answer: The platform has a 10MB file size limit per upload to ensure consistent performance across all users.
context: File size limits are enforced server-side to prevent storage overload.

question: How do I enable notifications on the mobile app?
answer: Go to your phone's Settings > Apps > [App Name] > Notifications and toggle them on, then check in-app notification settings too.
context: Notification permissions must be enabled both at the OS and app level.

question: Why is the dashboard showing incorrect data?
answer: This can occur due to caching delays; data usually syncs correctly within 15 minutes, or you can force a refresh.
context: Dashboard data syncs on a scheduled interval from the backend database.

question: Can I use the platform offline?
answer: Limited offline functionality is available on the mobile app, but changes will sync once you're back online.
context: Offline mode stores changes locally until connectivity is restored.

question: What file formats does the platform support?
answer: We support CSV, XLSX, PDF, and JSON file formats for both import and export.
context: Supported formats are listed under Settings > Import/Export Options.

question: Is there a mobile app available?
answer: Yes, the app is available for both iOS and Android and can be downloaded from the respective app stores.
context: The mobile app mirrors most core features of the web platform.

question: Does the product integrate with Slack?
answer: Yes, Slack integration is available under Settings > Integrations and allows real-time notifications in your workspace.
context: Integrations are managed through OAuth-based connections for security.

question: What languages does the platform support?
answer: The platform currently supports English, Spanish, French, German, and Japanese, with more languages planned.
context: Language settings can be changed under Account Settings > Preferences.

question: Is my data encrypted?
answer: Yes, all data is encrypted in transit using TLS and at rest using AES-256 encryption.
context: Encryption standards meet industry compliance requirements for data protection.

question: Can I export my data if I cancel my account?
answer: Yes, you can export all your data in CSV or JSON format anytime before or after cancellation, within 30 days.
context: Data export remains available during the 30-day post-cancellation retention period.

question: Does the platform have an API?
answer: Yes, a REST API is available for developers, with documentation found under Settings > Developer > API Keys.
context: API access requires generating a personal access key from account settings.

question: Why does my invoice show a different currency than expected?
answer: Invoices display the currency selected during signup; you can change your billing currency under Billing > Preferences.
context: Currency settings are locked to region unless manually updated by the user.

question: Can I split payment between two cards?
answer: Currently, only a single payment method can be used per transaction; split payments are not supported.
context: Payment processing is limited to one card or method per checkout session.

question: How do I remove an old payment method?
answer: Go to Billing > Payment Methods, select the old card, and click "Remove," provided it isn't your only active method.
context: At least one active payment method must remain on file for subscriptions.

question: Why did I receive an email saying my account was accessed from a new device?
answer: This is a security notification triggered whenever login occurs from an unrecognized device or location.
context: New-device alerts help users detect unauthorized account access quickly.

question: How do I change my account's time zone?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Preferences and select your time zone from the dropdown menu to update all timestamps.
context: Time zone settings affect how dates and times are displayed platform-wide.

question: Can I use multiple discount codes on one order?
answer: Only one discount code can be applied per order, and it will be applied automatically at checkout.
context: Discount code stacking is disabled to maintain consistent promotional pricing.

question: What payment methods do you accept for orders?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay for all orders.
context: Accepted payment methods are displayed at checkout based on your region.

question: Do you refund shipping costs?
answer: Shipping costs are refunded only if the return is due to our error, such as a wrong or damaged item.
context: Standard returns for buyer's remorse do not include shipping cost refunds.

question: How do I initiate a return for a refund?
answer: Go to Order History, select the item, and click "Start Return" to receive a prepaid shipping label.
context: Return requests must be initiated within 14 days of delivery for eligibility.

question: Can I schedule a specific delivery date?
answer: Scheduled delivery is available for select regions at checkout, shown as an option if eligible.
context: Scheduled delivery depends on carrier availability in the destination zip code.

question: What do I do if my package arrives damaged?
answer: Take photos of the damaged item and packaging, then submit a claim through Support within 48 hours of delivery.
context: Damage claims require photo evidence for carrier insurance processing.

question: How do I recover my account if I forgot my registered email?
answer: Contact support with your name, approximate signup date, and any order numbers so we can help locate your account.
context: Account recovery without email access requires manual identity verification.

question: Is there a limit to how many devices I can be logged in on?
answer: You can be logged in on up to 5 devices simultaneously; logging in on a 6th will sign out the oldest session.
context: Device session limits prevent unauthorized account sharing.

question: What happens to my subscription if my payment method expires?
answer: You'll receive an email reminder before expiration, and if not updated, your subscription will pause until payment is resolved.
context: Expiration reminders are sent 7 days before the card's expiry date.

question: Can I gift a subscription to someone else?
answer: Yes, gift subscriptions can be purchased on the pricing page and sent via email with redemption instructions.
context: Gift subscriptions are activated once the recipient redeems the emailed code.

question: Why am I not receiving verification emails?
answer: Check your spam folder first; if not found, ensure your email provider isn't blocking our domain, or request a resend after 5 minutes.
context: Verification emails can be delayed by spam filters or provider rate limits.

question: How do I report a bug I found?
answer: Use the "Report a Bug" option in the Help menu, including steps to reproduce the issue and any screenshots.
context: Bug reports are routed directly to the engineering team's tracking system.

question: Does the platform support dark mode?
answer: Yes, dark mode can be enabled under Account Settings > Appearance and syncs across all your devices.
context: Appearance settings are stored per user profile, not per device.

question: What's the maximum number of team members I can add?
answer: Team member limits depend on your plan: 5 for Pro, 20 for Premium, and unlimited for Enterprise.
context: Team limits are enforced at the account level based on subscription tier.

question: How do I change my account's linked phone number?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Security, select "Edit Phone Number," and verify the new number via SMS code.
context: Phone number changes require SMS verification to prevent account hijacking.

question: Why am I being billed in advance for next month?
answer: Subscriptions are billed in advance at the start of each cycle to ensure uninterrupted service access.
context: Advance billing is standard practice for subscription-based services.

question: Can I add a gift message to my order?
answer: Yes, you can add a gift message during checkout under the "Gift Options" section before completing your purchase.
context: Gift messages are printed on a separate slip, not the invoice, to hide pricing.

question: Why does my refund amount differ from what I paid?
answer: Refund amounts may be adjusted for used services, non-refundable fees, or currency conversion differences.
context: Partial usage and processing fees can reduce the final refunded amount.

question: Do you offer local pickup instead of shipping?
answer: Local pickup is available at select warehouse locations, selectable at checkout if you're within range.
context: Local pickup availability is determined by proximity to fulfillment centers.

question: Why am I asked to verify my identity every time I log in?
answer: This may happen if you've disabled "Remember this device" or are logging in from a new IP address frequently.
context: Repeated verification is a security measure for accounts flagged as high-risk.

question: Can I switch plans more than once a month?
answer: Yes, there's no limit to how often you switch plans, though each change is prorated based on usage.
context: Frequent plan switching is allowed but may result in multiple small charges.

question: Why does the app show "No Internet Connection" when I'm connected?
answer: This can happen if the app's servers are temporarily unreachable; check our status page or restart the app.
context: Connectivity errors are distinct from actual device internet issues.

question: Is there a limit on storage space for my account?
answer: Storage limits vary by plan: 5GB for Free, 100GB for Pro, and 1TB for Premium accounts.
context: Storage usage can be monitored under Account Settings > Storage.

question: How do I opt out of marketing emails?
answer: Click "Unsubscribe" at the bottom of any marketing email, or disable them under Account Settings > Notifications.
context: Transactional emails like receipts are not affected by marketing opt-out.

question: What is a "pending" charge on my statement?
answer: A pending charge is an authorization hold that will either finalize or drop off within 3-5 business days.
context: Pending charges are common with card pre-authorization for subscription verification.

question: Why was my order cancelled automatically?
answer: Orders are auto-cancelled if payment fails verification or if the item goes out of stock before processing.
context: Automatic cancellations trigger an immediate refund to the original payment method.

question: Can I get a refund in a different currency than I paid?
answer: Refunds are issued in the original currency and payment method used for the purchase, per processor rules.
context: Currency conversion for refunds follows the payment processor's exchange policy.

question: How do I add special delivery instructions?
answer: Enter delivery instructions in the "Notes for Courier" field during checkout, which is passed to the shipping carrier.
context: Special instructions are visible to carriers but not guaranteed to be followed.

question: Can I use the same account on web and mobile simultaneously?
answer: Yes, your account syncs across web and mobile, and you can be logged in on both at the same time.
context: Cross-platform sessions are synced in real time via the backend account system.

question: Is there a student discount available?
answer: Yes, students with a valid .edu email can get 20% off by verifying their status under Billing > Student Discount.
context: Student verification is handled through a third-party education verification service.

question: Why do images fail to load on the platform?
answer: This is often caused by ad blockers or browser extensions blocking image scripts; try disabling them temporarily.
context: Image loading issues are frequently linked to third-party browser extensions.

question: Does the platform offer accessibility features for visually impaired users?
answer: Yes, we support screen readers, keyboard navigation, and adjustable text sizing to meet WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards.
context: Accessibility compliance is tested regularly against WCAG guidelines.
